````text
# #4555: CI: daily super run failed
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 45102487076](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45102487076) on `_staging` (`5c99ba4`, workflow_dispatch) failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [fuzz (2/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45102487076/job/137459373342) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: this run is on `_staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `_staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix, and `_staging` holds still until this issue closes (scripts/promote-staging.sh, the freeze). Fix every failed job here, in the one pull request on `main` that closes this: when it closes, `_staging` takes main's first green commit after the close and the super run starts on it at once, and a run still red opens a new issue. Before you start, look for an open pull request or issue already fixing one of these jobs, and build on it instead of fixing the same test twice. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45107953647)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Make the daily super run's `fuzz (2/4)` job pass again. I rebuilt the job locally on `ee62186ec2`, which is staging's `5c99ba4` plus six commits that change no play code. Its plain wave (seeds 3126–6250) and its Duos wave (501–1000) pass. Its handicapped wave fails on two seeds, and each needs a fix:
- **Seed 4338** fails I18. The attacker is a fused Starship that holds S #104 Reflective Plating and has Trample. Its strike back (6) is dealt again to p1's hero after a 9-damage Trample excess, taking the hero from 13 to −2. The forecast's `overflow.kills` reads the excess alone and says the attack does not end the game. I18 skips only reflections from the defending side.
- **Seed 6138** fails I19, and it is an engine bug. M #97.4 Mega Church's wide Tribute paid with p2's S+ #63 Overdrive Dome while that Field Spell lay Dormant. The backrow walk in `legal_tribute_units` has no Dormant check. The spec's catalog row says "every permanent acting on the field", and R1839000 lists a Tribute among the rules that pass a Dormant card by.

Done means: a wide Tribute never takes a Dormant card (R4555000); I18 does not judge an attack on a Unit by an attacker that reflects what it takes onto the enemy hero (R4555001); each has a ruling and a test; and the two seeds and the whole handicapped wave pass. I tried both fixes on a scratch copy: all three shard-2 waves pass, and `classify --claims` against the base build says `Internal`, so no patch fragment is needed.

**Files to touch.**

| Path | new/change | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs` | change | `legal_tribute_units`: the backrow walk skips a Dormant card; doc comment |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` | change | `foreseeable_attack`: a new skip for an attacker that reflects damage; a new doc bullet |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/blueprint.rs` | change | test `r4555000_…` in `mod r1282_wide_tribute` |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs` | change | test `r4555001_…` after `r4221004_…` |
| `spec/rulings/R4555000.md` | new | ruling note |
| `spec/rulings/R4555001.md` | new | ruling note |
| `spec/pending/4555.md` | new | both §11 paragraphs |
| `spec/08-catalog.md` | change | row 97.4's Engine column: one phrase |
| `spec/rulings/R4111000.md` | change | add an "Amended by [[R4555001]]" paragraph |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`, `crates/cards/` (scripts and `patches/`; no fragment), `crates/tools/`, `crates/ai/`, `apps/`. The rules that govern this: §6.1 Dormant, §6.3 Tribute, §8 row 97.4, §4.4 step 8a, §9.10, R13, R1282, R1839000, R1849003, R3100000, R4111000, R4221004, R4290000.

**Steps.**

1. **`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs`, `legal_tribute_units`, the R1282 wide-Tribute backrow loop (`for slot in crate::zones::slots_of(side, Row::Backrow)`).** In the `if let Some(c) = crate::zones::card_at(state, slot) && c.id != card.id && …` chain, add this line right after `&& c.id != card.id`:
   ```rust
                    && !crate::slumber::is_slumbering(c)
   ```
   `is_slumbering` is already used in this file (around lines 478 and 1149). Leave the Units walks alone: `active_units_of` already leaves Dormant cards out. In the doc comment above the function, change the last sentence `Dormant cards never.` to `Never a card dormant beneath a Stack pile (R13), nor a Dormant one (R1839000, R4555000).`

2. **`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`, `foreseeable_attack`.** Insert this right before `let pool_soaks_reflection = …`:
   ```rust
    // R4555001: an attacker that reflects what it takes onto the enemy hero (Reflective Plating, R1849003).
    if target.is_some() && crate::scripts::flags_of(state, attacker).reflects_damage == Some(true) {
        return false;
    }
   ```
   Both faces of the Plating set `reflects_damage`. A fusion carries the flag through `fuse.rs`, and `damage::reflect_damage` reads the same `flags_of`. Append a last bullet to the function's doc list, after the bullet ending "which the forecast is not shown.":
   ```
   /// - for a Unit target, an attacker that reflects what it takes onto the enemy hero (Stinkyscape #104
   ///   Reflective Plating, either face, R1849003): its strike back is dealt again to the target's hero
   ///   after any Trample excess and may end the game, and the forecast projects no reflection (R4555001;
   ///   fuzz seed 4338).
   ```
   Leave the module header's I18 line as it is: it already says "a reflection".

3. **`crates/engine/tests/rules/blueprint.rs`, inside `mod r1282_wide_tribute`, after `r1282_cheap_reads_its_declared_number`.** Add the test `r4555000_a_wide_tribute_never_takes_a_dormant_backrow_card` (Tests, below). Use the module's `board`, `register_blueprint`, `put`, `slot`, `give_hand`, `act_result` and `find_instance_mut`. `Slumber` comes in through `jackioh_engine::testkit::*`.

4. **`crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs`, after `r4221004_i18_an_attack_on_a_reflector_into_the_attacker_s_pool_is_not_judged`.** Add the test `r4555001_i18_an_attack_on_a_unit_by_a_reflector_is_not_judged`. Copy the `register_i18_script` and `StaticFlags { reflects_damage: Some(true), .. }` pattern from `r4221004`, but put the flag on `&plain.id` (the attacker), not on `big_body`.

5. **`spec/rulings/R4555000.md` (new).**
   ```
   ---
   id: R4555000
   title: "A wide Tribute never takes a Dormant card, a Dormant Field Spell in either backrow included (issue #4555)"
   cards: "§6.1, §6.3, R13, R1282, R1839000; M #97.4 Mega Church, S+ #63 Overdrive Dome (issue #4555)"
   proven_in:
     - crates/engine/tests/rules/blueprint.rs
   ---
   ```
   For the body, write in prose:
   - What happened: the fuzz monitor's I19 found Mega Church's wide Tribute ([[R1282]]) paying with the opponent's Overdrive Dome while it lay Dormant in their backrow (handicapped fuzz seed 6138).
   - Why: the backrow walk read whatever topped each zone, and only the Units' walk (`active_units_of`) passed a Dormant card by.
   - The rule: a Dormant card does not act, is no Unit, and a Tribute passes it by ([[R1839000]]); the row's "every permanent acting on the field" says the same.
   - The change: `legal_tribute_units` now passes by a Dormant card in either backrow on either side. `legalActions` lists no set holding one, the reducer refuses a play naming one, and an awake permanent beside it pays as before.
   - Then the line: "Hearthstone semantics: a Dormant minion can be neither chosen nor affected until it awakens."
   - Rejected: letting a Tribute, a cost rather than an effect, take a Dormant card, against [[R1839000]]'s list.

6. **`spec/rulings/R4555001.md` (new).**
   ```
   ---
   id: R4555001
   title: "The fuzz's I18 does not judge an attack on a Unit by an attacker that reflects what it takes onto the enemy hero (issue #4555)"
   cards: "§4.4, §9.10, R1849003, R3100000, R4111000, R4221004, R4290000; S #104 Reflective Plating (issue #4555)"
   proven_in:
     - crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs
   ---
   ```
   For the body:
   - What happened (handicapped seed 4338): a fused Starship holding Reflective Plating attacked a Unit with Trample. The forecast ([[R3100000]]) foretold 9 trampling onto a hero at 13 with no kill, and the attack ended the game.
   - Why: the Plating dealt the attacker's 6 strike back again to the enemy hero ([[R1849003]], [[§4.4]] step 8a) after the excess. The overflow's `kills` ([[R4290000]]) reads the hero's fall at the step's end, and the forecast projects no reflection.
   - The change: [[R4111000]] and [[R4221004]] already skip the boards where the defending side's reflection changes what the forecast shows. I18 now also skips, by a named condition, an attack on a Unit whose attacker reflects what it takes onto the enemy hero.
   - Then the line: "Hearthstone semantics: the forecast is a derived fact, not a rule, and an invariant that checks it may judge only what it can see."
   - Rejected: counting the reflection in the overflow's `kills`. The figure the board draws as the Trample excess would then say the game ends on damage the excess does not deal; an attack without Trample would still have nowhere to show it; and the state-check passes cut short by the game's end would still be missed. Projecting the reflection in full is a forecast and wire change beyond a daily run's fix.

7. **`spec/rulings/R4111000.md`.** Append a last paragraph: `Amended by [[R4555001]] (issue #4555): I18 also skips an attack on a Unit whose attacker reflects what it takes onto the enemy hero ([[R1849003]]): its strike back lands again on the target's hero after any Trample excess, which the forecast does not project.`

8. **`spec/08-catalog.md`, row 97.4.** Replace the one occurrence of `never a card beneath a Stack, [[R13]])` with `never a card beneath a Stack, [[R13]], nor a Dormant one, [[R4555000]])`.

9. **`spec/pending/4555.md` (new).** Two paragraphs in the form `spec/pending/4524.md` uses: `**[[R4555000]] <its title without "(issue #4555)"> (issue #4555, 2026-11-23)**: <a two- or three-sentence summary>`, then the same for R4555001.

**Tests.**

- **`crates/engine/tests/rules/blueprint.rs`, `r4555000_a_wide_tribute_never_takes_a_dormant_backrow_card`.**
  - Setup: `board("r4555000-dormant-field")` and `register_blueprint()`. Put four `"bp-cheap-unit"`s in p1's unit lanes 1–4 and keep their ids. Put three `"bp-cheap-field"`s: `mine` in p1's backrow 1, `theirs` in p2's backrow 1, `awake` in p2's backrow 2. Stamp `mine` and `theirs` Dormant with `find_instance_mut(..).expect("on the field").slumber = Some(Slumber { turns: Some(2) })`. Then `church = give_hand(&mut state, "bp-church", P1)` and `state.players.p1.mana.current = 10`.
  - Assert that `legal_tribute_units(&state, P1, &church)` holds `awake.id` but neither `mine.id` nor `theirs.id`.
  - Assert that `legal_tribute_sets(&state, P1, &church)` is non-empty and no set contains `mine.id` or `theirs.id`.
  - Assert the reducer refuses: `act_result` on `{"type":"play","playerId":"p1","instanceId":church.id,"zone":{"row":"units","lane":5},"tributes":[four unit ids…, theirs.id]}` gives an `error` containing `"cannot be tributed"`.
  - Without step 1 this test fails.
- **`crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs`, `r4555001_i18_an_attack_on_a_unit_by_a_reflector_is_not_judged`.**
  - Setup: `i18_board("r4555001-i18-reflecting-attacker")`, then `register_i18_script(&plain.id, Script { static_flags: Some(StaticFlags { reflects_damage: Some(true), ..StaticFlags::default() }), ..Script::default() })`.
  - Assert the reflection happened: `i18_attack`'s `result.events` contains a `GameEvent::Damage { source_id: Some(attacker), target_id: "hero-p2", combat: false, .. }`.
  - Assert `judged_drift(&state, &attacker, &defender) == (0, Vec::new())`.
  - Without step 2 it gives `(1, [drift])`.
- Commands:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r4555`
  - the neighbouring tests: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r1282`, then `… i18`, then `… r1839000`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c097_4`
- Reproduce the daily job (each of these passed on my scratch copy with both fixes):
  - `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 4338 --seeds 1 --handicap`
  - `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 6138 --seeds 1 --handicap`
  - `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 400 --cards meditative-097-4,stinkyscapeplus-063,stinkyscape-104` and the same with `--handicap`. Without the fix, these fail on seed 379 (plain) and on seeds 92 and 271 (handicapped).
  - `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 3126 --seeds 3125 --handicap` (the failing wave, about 8 minutes on 4 cores)
  - `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` (CI's gate)

**Done when.**
- [ ] A wide Tribute skips Dormant backrow cards (step 1), and I18 skips an attack on a Unit by a reflecting attacker (step 2).
- [ ] Both new tests pass, and so do the existing `r1282`, `i18`, `r4111000`, `r4221004` and `c097_4` tests.
- [ ] Seeds 4338 and 6138 pass with `--handicap`, the forced-card waves pass, and `fuzz --from 3126 --seeds 3125 --handicap` reports 3125 passed.
- [ ] The two notes, `spec/pending/4555.md`, the §8 edit and the R4111000 amendment are in; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` reports nothing to claim, and `cargo jackioh patches check` passes.
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests.
- [ ] The report says the fix makes `fuzz (2/4)` pass and gives the seeds and commands above as the check.

**Risks.**
- **Determinism and replay.** Step 1 changes `legalActions` only when a cheap Dormant backrow card is present. The listing and the reducer both read `legal_tribute_units`, so I8 and I14 stay consistent. No replay or golden game hits this case: the shard-2 waves, CI's 200 seeds and `classify`'s 200 unforced games played the same.
- **Hiding a real bug.** The step 2 skip is narrow: a Unit target and the attacker's own `reflects_damage`. It cost about 1% of judged attacks in a Plating-forced wave (3382 → 3350) and none of the fuzz's other checks. Do not widen it to the attacker's side or to hero targets.
- **The AI and the client** read tribute sets through `legalActions` alone, so no AI or web change is needed (CLAUDE.md rules 4 and 7).
- **Ruling numbers.** Use exactly R4555000 and R4555001, and cite them only where the steps say.

**Open questions.**
- I couldn't read the CI log. The failing seeds come from my local rerun of the job's own commands on `ee62186ec2`, which differs from staging's `5c99ba4` only in commits that change no play code. If the PR's daily rerun still shows red, the next pass should start from that log.
- Rejected alternative, for a person to decide later: change the combat forecast to show the Plating's reflection. That would be a new wire field drawn by `AttackOutcome.tsx`, so it belongs in its own issue, not in a daily-run fix.
````
